speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in more detail; specifically, how long have you had the double vision, and is the weakness in your arms symmetrical or on one side?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The symptoms of diplopia worsening with specific gaze directions, combined with fluctuating weakness that improves with rest and fatigues with activity, are classic presentations of Myasthenia Gravis.
